Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000628": The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000604": Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: team Dune, image resizer, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)

- memory_id "1000495" [decision]: As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000491": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler's runbook.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000451": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000448" [decision]: The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000180": The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000838": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000771": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service.  (about: Ember team, the marketing send, billing service)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000377": The Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate rise and pinged the authentication gateway's owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000619": feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of them were identical.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000362": feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
